svg.title: Two parent flows, one child flow for the rule, one child flow for failures
svg.desc: On the left two parent flows: Cedar – First response sent (email) and Cedar – First response sent (phone call). Each keeps only its trigger and one action, Run a Child Flow with retry policy None, passing CaseId and Source. In the middle the child flow Cedar – Mark first response (child): manual trigger with the text inputs CaseId and Source; a Try scope with Get the case, Outcome and a condition that updates First Response Sent when the outcome is marked; a Catch scope that runs after Try has failed or timed out and builds an error text; a Respond action in the finally position that always answers with result and message; and a Terminate with status Failed when Try did not succeed. The contract: result is one of marked, already-marked, inactive or failed; message is empty or names the failed action and the error. Back in the parent a condition runs after the child call whatever its status: when the call failed or the result is failed, it calls the second child, Cedar – Report flow failure (child), with flow name, run link, failed step, message and record, and then ends with Terminate Failed. On the right the report child sends one mail to the address in an environment variable and answers reported yes or no. Notes: both children live in the same solution as the parents; children with connectors other than Dataverse need their connections embedded under Run only users; a child cannot receive connections from the parent.
svg.text: One rule in one place: parents call, the child decides, a second child reports

call not Succeeded OR result = failed → Report the failure (child 2) → Terminate (Failed)
Same solution. A child cannot receive connections from its parent: connectors other than
